data.name: AnalyzerDescription
data.value: Type names should be all uppercase
data.comment: An optional longer localizable description of the diagnostic

data.name: AnalyzerMessageFormat
data.value: Type name '{0}' contains lowercase letters.
data.comment: The format-able message the diagnostic displays

data.name: AnalyzerTitle
data.value: Type name contains lowercase letters

data.name: FieldUsedTitle
data.value: Field used in method
data.comment: The title of the diagnostic for field usage in methods

data.name: FieldUsedMessageFormat
data.value: Field '{0}' is used in method '{1}'
data.comment: The format-able message the diagnostic displays when a field is used in a method

data.name: FieldUsedDescription
data.value: Warns when a field is used in any method
data.comment: An optional longer localizable description of the diagnostic for field usage

data.name: FieldAccessedExternallyTitle
data.value: Field or property accessed outside declaring class
data.comment: The title of the diagnostic for external field/property access

data.name: FieldAccessedExternallyMessageFormat
data.value: The field or property '{0}' is accessed from outside its declaring class '{1}'
data.comment: The format-able message the diagnostic displays when a field or property is accessed externally

data.name: FieldAccessedExternallyDescription
data.value: Warns when a field or property is accessed from outside its declaring class, which may indicate state escape or a violation of encapsulation
data.comment: An optional longer localizable description of the diagnostic for external field/property access

data.name: FieldDoesNotUseLockDescription
data.value: Warn when a field or property accessor is publicly visible and doesn't use a lock

data.name: FieldDoesNotUseLockTitle
data.value: Accessor is publicly available but doesn't use a lock

data.name: FieldDoesNotUseLockMessageFormat
data.value: The Accessor '{0}' in '{1}' can be called from outside its declaring class and doesn't use a lock

data.name: TestRuleTitle
data.value: Test Rule

data.name: TestRuleDescription
data.value: An anonymous test rule

data.name: TestRuleMessageFormat
data.value: Test rule: '{0}' and '{1}' and '{2}'

data.name: InternalFieldNoLockTitle
data.value: Field or property not properly synchronized

data.name: InternalFieldNoLockDescription
data.value: Internal field or property not properly synchronized

data.name: InternalFieldNoLockMessageFormat
data.value: The field '{0}' in '{1}' is exposed through method '{2}' without a lock

data.name: LockObjectExposedTitle
data.value: Lock object publicly exposed

data.name: LockObjectExposedDescription
data.value: A lock object is being exposed via a public accessor

data.name: LockObjectExposedMessageFormat
data.value: The Lock '{0}' in class '{1}' is publicly exposed via accessor '{2}'

data.name: PublicFieldExposedTitle
data.value: Public field exposes internal state

data.name: PublicFieldExposedDescription
data.value: Public fields break encapsulation. Use properties with appropriate accessor modifiers instead

data.name: PublicFieldExposedMessageFormat
data.value: Field '{0}' is public. {1}

data.name: ConflictingAccessThreadTitle
data.value: Conflicting access between threads

data.name: ConflictingAccessThreadMessageFormat
data.value: There is a conflicting access on field '{0}' between Thread '{1}' and Thread '{2}'

data.name: ConflictingAccessThreadDescription
data.value: Conflicting accesses in threads where atleast one access is a write

data.name: SP001Title
data.value: Field is not safely published

data.name: SP001MessageFormat
data.value: Field '{0}' is not safely published. Declare it as 'readonly' or 'volatile' to ensure safe publication

data.name: SP001Description
data.value: All fields should be safely published by being readonly, volatile, or initialized to a default value without relying on constructor logic

data.name: SP003Title
data.value: Virtual method called in constructor

data.name: SP003MessageFormat
data.value: Constructor of '{0}' calls virtual method '{1}'. A derived class override may run before the derived constructor body, observing uninitialized fields

data.name: SP003Description
data.value: Calling a virtual method in a constructor is unsafe when a derived class overrides it and reads fields that are set in the derived constructor body, not in initializers

data.name: VolatileReorderingTitle
data.value: Possible volatile store/load reordering

data.name: VolatileReorderingMessageFormat
data.value: The volatile read '{0}' in method '{1}' is at risk of being reordered to happen before the volatile write '{2}' in the same method

data.name: VolatileReorderingDescription
data.value: In C# a volatile write followed by a volatile read may be reordered without a full-fence memory barrier

data.name: InconsistentLockUseTitle
data.value: Inconsistent Lock usage on field or property

data.name: InconsistentLockUseDescription
data.value: Access to this field or property is not always synchronized by the same lock

data.name: InconsistentLockUseMessageFormat
data.value: The field '{0}' uses lock '{1}' but other places it uses lock '{2}'

data.name: LockOnClassInstanceTitle
data.value: Do not use 'lock (this)'

data.name: LockOnClassInstanceDescription
data.value: Locking on 'this' exposes the sync object to external callers, which can lead to deadlocks

data.name: LockOnClassInstanceMessageFormat
data.value: The class '{0}' uses 'lock (this)' in method '{1}'. This can cause deadlocks if external code also locks on the instance. Use a private lock object instead

data.name: ConflictingAccessRuleTitle
data.value: Conflicting access to shared mutable state across members

data.name: ConflictingAccessRuleDescription
data.value: Multiple class members access the same mutable field concurrently without a shared lock, where at least one operation is a write. This can introduce data races and memory reordering bugs

data.name: ConflictingAccessRuleMessageFormat
data.value: Method '{1}()' can conflict with method '{2}()' on the shared state '{0}' because they lack proper synchronization and at least one method is a write operation.
